name: simready-assets
title: SimReady Assets
description: Browse, preview, and search NVIDIA's SimReady Assets on Hugging Face. Download only the assets you need.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: simready-assets
commands.title: Search Assets
commands.subtitle: SimReady Assets
commands.description: Search NVIDIA's SimReady Assets, preview 3D models, and browse individual files to download on demand.

tools.name: search-assets
tools.title: Search Assets
tools.description: Search or browse NVIDIA's SimReady Assets by name, type, and variant. Returns a page of assets with Hugging Face links without downloading asset content.

tools.name: list-asset-types
tools.title: List Asset Types
tools.description: List available types in NVIDIA's SimReady Assets with asset counts. Use these type names to filter Search Assets.

tools.name: get-asset-details
tools.title: Get Asset Details
tools.description: Inspect one SimReady asset's size, license, root models, and preview URL. Returns a command for downloading only that asset folder; never runs commands or downloads asset content.

tools.name: list-asset-files
tools.title: List Asset Files
tools.description: Browse or search one SimReady asset's files by filename and group. Returns a page of file sizes, Hugging Face pages, and individual download links without downloading the files.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
